messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Over-the-counter omeprazole is used for:
- frequent heartburn that occurs 2 or more days a week in adults 18 years and older
- It is taken as a 14-day course, once a day for 14 days in a row. It may take 1 to 4 days to reach its full effect, so it is not used for immediate relief of symptoms. Do not take it for longer than 14 days, and do not start another 14-day course within 4 months, unless your doctor tells you to.
Prescription omeprazole can be used for:
- active duodenal ulcer (a sore in the first part of the small intestine) in adults
- Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection in adults, taken together with antibiotics, to reduce the risk of a duodenal ulcer coming back
- active benign gastric ulcer (a non-cancerous sore in the stomach lining) in adults
- symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), such as heartburn, in adults and children 1 year of age and older
- erosive esophagitis (EE) caused by acid reflux in adults and children 1 month of age and older
- keeping erosive esophagitis healed after treatment, in adults and children 1 year of age and older
- pathological hypersecretory conditions (conditions in which the stomach makes too much acid) in adults, including Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
Triplet: ["omeprazole", "used for", "pathological hypersecretory conditions in adults including Zollinger-Ellison syndrome"]

The relation 'used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used to treat, manage, or address the medical condition or symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'helps reduce': The subject drug is used to decrease or lessen the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
